Licence, Security & Trustworthiness – 8.5/10

Before 2025, 96M online casino operates under the Curacao Gaming Board license, specifically the #365/JAZ framework. The master licensing structure, which is provided by the Gaming Services Provider N.V., widely known as the Gaming Curacao, grants sub-licenses to private online casinos like 96M. With the license, the casino can offer online casino and betting services with minimal oversight and regulations to players in Malaysia, Cambodia, and beyond Asia.

However, as of August 18, 2024, the Gaming Curacao has suspended operations associated with N.V. 365/JAZ gaming licenses. Hence, casinos still showing the sub-license or master license on their website are considered fraudulent. Thus, players are encouraged to tread carefully and possibly request the latest valid license from the casino before signing up. Meanwhile, it is worth noting that 96M remains a secure and heavily protected casino, as it utilizes a 128-bit SSL encryption system, Cloudflare DDoS protection, and a verification system. Additionally, the RNG technology has been audited and approved by independent testing laboratories, including iTechLabs and Bmm.

As a bettor in Malaysia, joining a trusted online casino is easy, but you should be aware of the grey-market player status associated with it. 96M online casino is among the offshore online casinos, which the current Common Gaming Houses and Betting Acts 1953 have yet to properly address. While Malaysian laws frown upon and prohibit betting, it is unclear about online betting platforms. These are widely accessible to players in Malaysia.

Despite the grey area associated with the license and legitimacy, the Malaysian online casino remains a popular brand and is hugely trusted. More importantly, Jacky Wu endorses the platform as a brand ambassador, who is one of the most popular faces in the entertainment industry in Asia. With the prestige and fame carried by Jacky Wu, many players in Malaysia and beyond trust the casino more than many online offshore betting sites.
